blocks.text: New Media Core Elective Table I
Not all courses will be offered every year, subject to course intentions and resource allocations.
Enrolment is subject to course requisites and timetabling constraints. Some courses are only available at night.
For students admitted Fall 2025 and before

links.text: For students admitted Fall 2025 and before

blocks.text: Six (6) courses are required from Table I.
Students must complete a minimum of four (4) of the following New Media/Fine Art courses:
Some course codes in this program have changed. See RTA-NMA Course Code Conversion Chart for further information.
NMA 323 Contemporary Issues in New Media Art
NMA 825 Global Experiential Intensive - New Media
NMA 832 Cybernetics and Body Centric Technologies
NMA 933 Hacking, DIY and Open Source Studio
NMA 946 Issues in New Media Theory/History
BPM 905 History and Culture of Popular Music
FCD 240 History of Art and Design: Global Survey
FCD 810 Immersion in Communication and Design
FCD 816 Global Campus Studio Supercourse I
NMA 828 Special Topics in Game Design
RTA 317 Escape Rooms and Immersive Experiences
RTA 847 Artificial Intelligence - Music and Audio
RTA 848 Esports and Online Streaming Production
RTA 945 Writing for Factual and Reality Programs
RTA 970 Lighting, Grip and Effects Specialty
RTA 971 Audio Post Production and Sound Design
RTA 975 Video Compositing and Visual Effects
RTA 992 Social and Interactive Media for Sports

*Available as a Table I course only to students admitted Fall 2025. ** RTA 311 and RTA 314 have a GPA weight of 2.00 and a course count of 2.00. † RTA 802 and RTA 803 have a GPA weight of 2.00 and a course count of 2.00.
